steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The crucifixion demonstrates the depth of God's love — God was willing to suffer the most painful and humiliating death to save humanity. Christians remember this through the symbol of the cross. | RS Exam Tips — The Crucifixion and Resurrection: 1. For The Crucifixion and Resurrection questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Crucifixion and Resurrection to its real-world impact on believers and society

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the crucifixion and resurrection, and one past-paper question.
